title: 有馬記念の後に・諦念と

text_block_list.text: Gold City wins against Tamamo Cross. Despite her victory, the crowd still obsesses over her appearance rather than her strength.
Conversely, Tamamo Cross is noted for her running, even though she lost. The difference in treatment devastates Gold City.
Tamamo Cross is angered by Gold City's gutless performance and asks her why she runs in the first place, but Gold City can't find an answer.
When she talks to me, she quietly concedes that nothing she does will ever change her reputation. But when asked if she would stop running, she does nothing to affirm.
Unconvinced that she truly wants to give up, I decide to register her for the Osaka Hai, with my eyes now set on the Senior Spring Triple Crown.
